cohort: Patients admitted for MTP, abortion, and delivery after short inter-pregnancy interval with previous caesarean delivery.
finding: Short interpregnancy interval after previous caesarean delivery was associated with adverse maternal outcomes (anemia, scar dehiscence, uterine rupture, PPH, PROM, premature delivery) and fetal outcomes (low birth weight, preterm birth, IUFD, stillbirth, neonatal death).
